data.name: ChronosGuessr
data.detailed_description:
BECOME A WITNESS TO WORLD HISTORY

CHRONOSGUESSR is an endless journey through time. Forget boring quizzes and outline maps. CHRONOSGUESSR challenges you in a game where space and time merge into one. You are not just guessing a spot on the globe. You are decoding the cultural code of civilizations, relying only on your eyes and your knowledge.

YOUR JOURNEY HAS NO BORDERS

Find yourself at the heart of the great events that shaped our world. Look around: every detail, from the cut of a passerby’s clothes to the architecture and everyday objects, is a key to the solution. Are you standing on the market square of a medieval city, or among ancient ruins at the moment of their glory? The right answer is hidden in the small things.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Competitive Mode (Ranked): Prove your superiority in intense ranked matches. Climb the leaderboards by fighting the best historians and strategists from around the world.

  • A growing universe: At launch, more than 1,000 unique scenes are available, and this is only the beginning. The library of historical panoramas is regularly expanded, covering new regions and eras.

  • Stunning visuals: Each location is a highly artistic reconstruction in Ultra-HD quality. Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the past with cinematic panoramas and a true sense of presence.

  • A multinational experience: Explore events that matter to all of world history. The game spans every continent, offering a truly global view of the past.

  • A double challenge: Guessing the place is only half the battle. Can you determine the year of the event with decade-level accuracy?

  • Explore and win: Competition combined with deep immersion helps you learn facts you will not find in ordinary guidebooks.

ARE YOU READY TO CONQUER TIME?

In CHRONOSGUESSR, history stops being a static picture. Every panorama is a living mystery, and every ranked match is a chance to make history yourself. Test your eye, your logic, and become the ultimate champion of chronology.

Add it to your wishlist and begin your great journey through the centuries!

data.short_description: “History isn't dates in a textbook—it's the place you just ended up in.” CHRONOSGUESSR is a global test of intuition. Travel through eras, exploring thousands of detailed historical panoramas worldwide. Compete in ranked matches and prove you know best WHERE and WHEN time froze.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with WebGL 2.0 support
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5 or better
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with WebGL 2.0 support
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
